truths.truth: ROADMAP criterion 1 / WIN-02: after an upgrade over v1.20.1 the app shows its tray icon and no 'Unhandled exception in script' dialog
truths.evidence: No automated check exercises the tray icon or the dialog. check_upgraded (packaging/windows/smoke.sh:263-266) only requires the PID alive for 5 s after health. hqptuner.spec:81 builds windowed on Windows (console only on linux), and the tray runs on the main thread after the server's daemon thread starts (hqptuner/desktop.py:224-226,258-263), so a tray-load exception yields PyInstaller's windowed error dialog in a process that stays alive. .planning/phases/3/CONTEXT.md flagged assumptions names exactly this ('a windowed PyInstaller error dialog keeps the process alive, and AC1 or AC2 passes on a broken build'), and SUMMARY.md Goal check concedes 'no check looks for the tray icon or the "Unhandled exception in script" dialog'. The reported FileNotFoundError was never reproduced (step 8 passed pre-fix), so no run shows the proxy going red on that symptom.

gaps.name: After an upgrade over v1.20.1 the app shows its tray icon and no 'Unhandled exception in script' dialog (ROADMAP criterion 1, WIN-02)
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - no automated check exercises it: the smoke checks a proxy (PID alive 5 s after health) that the phase's own CONTEXT says passes on a broken windowed build whose error dialog keeps the process alive
gaps.evidence: packaging/windows/smoke.sh:263-266 is the only post-health check besides the LAN health call; hqptuner.spec:81 windowed on Windows; hqptuner/desktop.py:258-263 tray on main thread after server thread; CONTEXT.md flagged assumption 3; SUMMARY.md Goal check 'Criterion 1 is checked by proxy only'. Pre-fix step 8 passed, so the proxy has never gone red on the reported symptom.
gaps.missing: The smallest check that closes it: in check_upgraded, after the 5 s window, fail when the upgraded PID owns a visible top-level window (e.g. PowerShell (Get-Process -Id <winpid>).MainWindowTitle non-empty, which is where the windowed PyInstaller error dialog shows; a healthy pystray app has none), printing the title. Its bite proof (docs/testing.md rule 8) is one red run of that check against a build whose tray load fails.
